history.task:
Rewrite layout.sh with this pattern: Master always 40% left. Workers in remaining 60%. 

Layout rules:
- 1 pane: Master 100%
- 2 panes: Master 40% | 1 worker
- 3 panes: Master 40% | 2 stacked
- 4 panes: Master 40% | 3 stacked
- 5 panes: Master 40% | 2x2 (two columns, 2 each)
- 6 panes: Master 40% | 2+3 (two columns)
- 7 panes: Master 40% | 3x3 (two columns, 3 each)
- 8 panes: Master 40% | 2+2+3 (three columns)
- 9 panes: Master 40% | 2+3+3 (three columns)
- 10 panes: Master 40% | 3x3x3 (three columns, 3 each)
- 11 panes: Master 40% | 3+3+4 (three columns)
- 12 panes: Master 40% | 3+4+4 (three columns)
- 13 panes: Master 40% | 4x4x4 (three columns, 4 each)

Pattern: columns = ceil(workers/4), distribute evenly, leftmost columns get fewer if uneven. Remove the old complex logic.
